description.zh: assistant-ui 条目页介绍 Thread 组件与 runtime、chat route 的关系；示例区显示一条用户消息和 assistant 回复，正文提到 Vercel AI SDK、Mastra 与 LangGraph。 给 AI 聊天界面做前端的 React 库：一个 runtime 管住 thread、stream 和 tool call，配一组 primitives。后端通过 adapters 接 AI SDK、LangGraph、LangChain、Mastra 或自研，CLI 会把 UI 源码拷进你的仓库。

reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by assistant-ui (https://www.assistant-ui.com/).
Technology stack: react, react-native, typescript.
Component specification: assistant-ui 条目页介绍 Thread 组件与 runtime、chat route 的关系；示例区显示一条用户消息和 assistant 回复，正文提到 Vercel AI SDK、Mastra 与 LangGraph。

Visual details from source observation: 首屏大标题 The frontend library for AI agents.，旁边挂着 npx assistant-ui init 一行命令和 12.2k GitHub stars、1.3M weekly downloads、Backed by Y Combinator 三个数据。紧接着嵌了一个真聊天窗：左栏有 New thread，中间只有一句 How can I help you today?。正文先把 WHAT YOU INSTALL 指向 @assistant-ui/react，再用 THE RUNTIME HANDLES 列出十件事，从 01 STREAMING 到 10 GENERATIVE UI，最后 THE PRIMITIVES 一段强调 the CLI copies the UI source into your repo，所以 ThreadPrimitive.Root、ComposerPrimitive.Input 这些都能直接改。导航里另有 React Native、Ink、tw-shimmer、Heat Graph、Safe Content Frame、react-o11y 几个独立产物。
Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
